summary: Read-only coverage investigation: existing verified account/project roster and reservation sources do not establish complete provider/session coverage. Production Stage C explicitly HOLDs first connection and terminal; use null coverage and do not dispatch until independently established evidence and separate dependencies are resolved.
nextAction: Lead: commission a separately scoped source-only provider/session authority adapter and independent review only if a real existing-auth issuer with complete account-wide coverage can be established; otherwise preserve HOLD. W19: retain null coverage, fail closed and do not manufacture sessions; separately reconcile accepted composition and reviewed planner publication before integration.
evidence:
Inspected clean reviewer2-stagec-19378518 at full commit 19378518c5469b1dda8eeaa9b2cd9e3f7d2f8c82 (task SHA is abbreviated); W19 checkpoint 13915; frozen, not independently accepted planner f397b796d447f3d728a464cf400665c755596870 scripts/jarvis-native-planner-bridge.md:20-26,49-77,92-99. Established: Client/Modules/AccountCapacityLedger.fs:38-54,405-418 binds account and project IDs/ledger/epoch and independently approved Git remote endpoints; NativeSchedulerRosterPolicy.fs:108-138 verifies configured project identities/limits and duplicate roster keys; NativeSchedulerAccountReservation.fs:55-60,200-253 verifies unique reservation records and exact roster/account/project heads with bounded observation age, explicitly NOT session completeness. Reservation absence is not evidence of no outside provider session. ReviewWorkflow.fs:485-526 stores optional agent associations, clears current ID upon stopping and can reset history; it is not an authenticated exhaustive provider registry. BrowserBridge.fs:226-249,304-338 keeps per-connection reported window snapshots, removes disconnected connections, detects ambiguous exact windows, and reports unknown pending outcomes; transport pairing does not authenticate provider account/session/turn, and disconnected/absent windows cannot prove inactivity. AutomationNativeProviderSessionHost.fs:10-20,315-331 explicitly disables dispatch and terminal release; Program.fs:331-350 compiles host default-off. AutomationNativeProviderTrustContract.fs:171-215 explicitly denies caller-shaped terminal proof. Server/Services/FeedbackStore.fs:243-251,304-350 stores user/project/agent last-seen only, with failed-write guard; HubService.fs:124-139 scopes verified activity to authenticated registered client and current-process coverage; restart/missing activity is not provider inactivity or enumeration. These sources provide partial facts, not full coverage, freshness/revocation or crash-proof provider lifecycle. No claim is made that a suitable provider API does not exist externally; no authenticated complete source was demonstrated in inspected code.
Smallest contract for separate implementer: a read-only adapter grounded in an actually verified existing-auth issuer, enumerate the entire declared account/roster scope with stable snapshot/watermark and explicit completeness, bind issuer/account to configured account identity and each record to exact project/ledger/epoch and agent/kind; record durable unique session identity, provenance, observation and expiry, revocation/issuer generation, and classify Active/Unknown/Inactive only from trustworthy lifecycle evidence. Validate and recheck account/project heads, roster, issuer generation and freshness at use; fail closed for absent/incomplete enumeration, truncation, mismatched identities/heads, stale/future/revoked/disconnected source, duplicates/contradictions or unassociated sessions. Active and Unknown consume capacity; prove safe correlation to reservations to avoid double count; unmatched reservations retain capacity. Restart/disconnect invalidates coverage until a complete fresh re-enumeration; retain uncertain effects and never infer no-send or replay. Snapshot vs provider event races need issuer watermark/fence or equivalent end-to-end proof, not merely matching Git heads. If issuer cannot guarantee this, contract returns unavailable and HOLD, not a fabricated complete empty set. No new signing/parallel auth implied.
Tests for separate implementation: authenticated full multi-project positive and truly verified empty snapshot; absent/partial/paginated/truncated/failed reads; foreign account/project/epoch/head, stale/future/revoked/reconnected issuer and concurrent head or watermark change; duplicate identity/conflicting associations; active/unknown/unassociated sessions, matched/unmatched reservations and quota accounting; disconnect/restart/drop/event gap and crash after uncertain send; no terminal or release from tab closure, missing activity or caller-shaped evidence. Assert no dispatch or capacity release under every unknown and no replay. These are proposed tests, not executed. Provider first-connect/terminal authority is a separate necessary dependency beyond registry coverage; source-only adapter alone does not authorize dispatch.
